title: WOFOST 8.1 Independent Potential Production Equivalence

evidence.potential_production_rule: test-only accepted aggregates must yield reltr=1 through the admitted production interface; no bypass of finalize_wofost_one_day_rates

scientific_interpretation: The Allard/PCSE suite is suitable independent oracle evidence, but current SWAP5 cannot yet be claimed equivalent to the complete YAML contract because several WOFOST 8.1 input transformations and output observations have not been demonstrated equivalent. Executing a partial comparison while silently dropping those fields would overstate qualification.

If those mappings exist, implement the test-only driver and run all ten trajectories. If N-state is genuinely outside the current standard WOFOST capability, decide explicitly whether to create a narrower carbon/phenology PP qualification rather than weakening F-WOF-PP01.
